gloss: copy paper; photocopy paper; printer paper

definitions.gloss: copy paper; photocopy paper; printer paper
definitions.explanation: standard white paper used for photocopying and printing

examples.japanese: コピー{用紙|ようし}が{切|き}れた。
examples.english: We ran out of copy paper.

examples.japanese: コピー{用紙|ようし}を{補充|ほじゅう}してください。
A4のコピー{用紙|ようし}を{一|いち}{箱|はこ}{注文|ちゅうもん}した。
examples.english: I ordered one box of A4 copy paper.

notes:
COMMON SIZES IN JAPAN:
- A4 (210×297mm) - most common
- B5 (182×257mm) - common in schools
- A3 (297×420mm) - for larger documents

RELATED TERMS:
- {上質紙|じょうしつし} (high-quality paper)
- {再生紙|さいせいし} (recycled paper)
- {裏紙|うらがみ} (scrap paper - back side of used paper)
